high_level_description: stc brand style, a digital art composition of a desert canyon with mystical purple and blue energy beams.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Towering red-orange sandstone canyon walls with natural striations, light beige sand, sparse desert vegetation, two small desert trees, and a soft blue sky with wispy clouds.

elements.desc: Purple and blue energy beams shooting from the top of the canyon, curving and interacting with the rock formations.
